distribution.selection: seeded random Real/AI sample; CASIA Tp proportional allocation by parsed filename group with up to 3-item floor; deterministic within-group sample; per-group 70/15/15 split; case-only variants are coalesced in canonical group reporting while raw filename tokens are retained.

interpretation: The candidate increased Original accuracy by +0.67 pp, Manipulated recall by +7.31 pp, and mean accuracy across the seven transformed conditions by +1.16 pp; its accuracy was higher in all seven conditions. The trade-off is lower Real recall (-4.00 pp), lower Manipulated precision (-4.15 pp), and +13 additional Real→Manipulated errors on 300 Real test images (16 to 29). It classified 2/3 of the supplied diagnostic examples as Manipulated on their original versions. The prediction-consistency values also vary by condition; they are listed in the comparison table. These measurements show a candidate trade-off, not a guarantee for other data or transformations.
